welStep1Text.message: CSV, XLSX ou colar. As colunas viram variáveis — %name%, %site%, %topic%. As linhas se juntam por site ou e-mail, então reimportar nunca duplica.
welStep1Text.description: %name%, %site% and %topic% are template variable names — keep them as they are.

welStep2Text.message: Spintax: {Oi|Olá} %name%… Cada linha ganha o seu próprio texto, reproduzível a partir da chave da linha. Peça um rascunho ao seu chat de IA — o prompt está a um clique.
welStep2Text.description: {Hi|Hello} is spintax syntax; the words inside may be translated, the braces and the pipe may not.

welStep3Text.message: Abra o painel lateral na página do destino, clique em Preencher, confira o formulário, clique em Enviar você mesmo e marque a linha. Os follow-ups voltam no dia certo.

welQuickText.message: Ficam no topo de todas as telas — abrem uma gaveta e nunca atrapalham o que você está fazendo.

welQuickRowsBlocked.message: Importe uma lista primeiro — as linhas precisam de colunas
welQuickRowsBlocked.description: Tooltip on the disabled "Add rows" chip.

welPanelOpenTarget.message: a página da linha (ou uma nova mensagem no seu app de e-mail / webmail — veja Configurações).
welPanelOpenTarget.description: Follows the quoted side-panel button name "Open target" and an em dash: "Open target — the row's page…".

welPanelFill.message: pede acesso ao site uma vez, preenche os campos reconhecidos e mostra um relatório por campo; em editores ricos o texto vai pela área de transferência.
welPanelFill.description: Follows the quoted side-panel button name "Fill on site.com" and an em dash.

welPanelSent.message: registra o resultado e segue em frente; "Não enviado…" e "Mais…" guardam os outros resultados.
welPanelSent.description: Follows the quoted side-panel button name "Sent — next (S)" and an em dash. "Not sent…" and "More…" quote panel buttons — use the same wording as panelNotSent / panelMore.

welPanelKeysLabel.description: Bold lead-in of the keyboard-shortcuts line; not a button name.

welPanelKeys.message: Enter = ação principal, S = enviado e próxima, N = próxima linha (fora dos campos de texto). Os atalhos globais você define na página de atalhos de extensões do navegador.
welPanelKeys.description: Follows the bold "Keys" and an em dash. S and N are the physical keys — keep them Latin.

welPanelMappingLabel.description: Bold lead-in quoting the side panel's field-mapping section.

welPanelMapping.message: o que foi para onde; aponte um campo que passou batido, fixe um campo, esqueça uma receita errada.
welPanelMapping.description: Follows the bold "Field mapping" and an em dash.

welPrivacyText.message: Tudo fica neste perfil do navegador: listas, modelos, registro, arquivos. Sem conta, sem telemetria, sem rede — a única requisição opcional é o feed de novidades do 301.sh, desligado por padrão. Faça backup e apague tudo em Configurações.

welNews.message: Novidades do autor — uma notificação quando o 301.sh publica um post (consulta a cada 6 horas, nada sobre você é enviado). Fica desligado até você clicar no sininho.
welNews.description: Follows the news bell button on the welcome page.

welPlayground.description: Link to the online spintax playground on 301.st.

colSummaryFew.message: Colunas ($COUNT$) — tipo, campos do formulário, padrões, dicas

stepFollowupDays.description: Follows the delay input; see stepFollowup for the whole line.

stepDelayAria.description: Accessible name of the delay input.

demoBannerSent.message: Demo: nada foi enviado. Marque a linha como enviada no painel lateral para seguir.

cmdActionTitle.description: Tooltip of the toolbar button and title of the Firefox sidebar.

wizFileError.message: Não foi possível ler o arquivo: $ERROR$

wizNoRowsFound.message: Nenhuma linha encontrada — veja se a primeira linha tem os cabeçalhos.

wizRowsOne.description: Row count in the import status line.

wizRowsFew.description: Row count in the import status line.

wizSkippedTitleRowsMany.message: $COUNT$ linhas de título acima do cabeçalho foram ignoradas.

wizSkippedTitleRowsOther.message: $COUNT$ linhas de título acima do cabeçalho foram ignoradas.
wizSkippedTitleRowsOther.description: Second sentence of the import status line: decorative rows above the real header were dropped.

wizBatchIntro.message: — uma fila que você percorre à mão. Importe um lote agora; depois abra o arquivo de novo para o próximo (as linhas já importadas se juntam pela chave).

wizBatchRowsLabel.description: Opens the batch form row: Rows [from] to [to] · batch of [size].

wizBatchTo.description: Between the first row of the batch (an input) and the last one (a number) in the batch form row.

wizBatchFirst.description: Button of the batch form row: jump back to the first N rows of the file. Lowercase on purpose.

wizBatchNext.description: Button of the batch form row: move on to the next N rows of the file. Lowercase on purpose.

wizBatchMax.description: Muted note next to the batch buttons: the hard cap on one batch.

wizContinueRolesOne.message: Ir para papéis e duplicatas ($COUNT$ linha)
wizContinueRolesOne.description: Primary button of wizard step 1, with the size of the batch it will carry over.

wizContinueRolesFew.message: Ir para papéis e duplicatas ($COUNT$ linhas)
wizContinueRolesFew.description: Primary button of wizard step 1, with the size of the batch it will carry over.

wizContinueRolesMany.message: Ir para papéis e duplicatas ($COUNT$ linhas)

wizNoTargetColumn.message: Escolha uma coluna de destino (URL / e-mail / @perfil) — linhas sem destino não podem ser importadas.
wizNoTargetColumn.description: Blocker on wizard step 2: no column carries the role "target" yet.

wizApplyImport.description: Primary button of wizard step 2: how many rows will be written (added plus updated).

wizNamingPastePlaceholder.message: cole a linha da resposta: id; email; phone; …

wizNamingPasteAria.message: Nomes de colunas da resposta da IA

wizNamingExpectedOne.description: The pasted answer did not carry one name per column. Keep the semicolon in the quotes — it is the separator the user must type.

wizNamingExpectedFew.description: The pasted answer did not carry one name per column. Keep the semicolon in the quotes — it is the separator the user must type.

wizPromptCopied.message: Prompt copiado — cole no seu chat de IA e traga a resposta para cá.
wizPromptCopied.description: The "name these columns" prompt reached the clipboard.

wizClipboardBlocked.message: Área de transferência bloqueada — selecione os nomes à mão.
wizClipboardBlocked.description: The browser refused clipboard access, so the prompt could not be copied.

wizCopyNamingPrompt.description: Button that copies a prompt for an AI chat. The prompt itself is sent to a model and stays English.

wizApplyNames.description: Button that renames the columns from the pasted answer line.

wizColumnNameAria.description: Accessible name of the header input in the roles table.

wizVariableTitle.description: Tooltip of the header input: the template variable this column feeds. The percent signs are spintax syntax — keep them around the name, and leave the name itself as it is.

wizRoleFor.description: Accessible name of the role dropdown. COLUMN is the user's own column header — data, never translated.

wizRoleNone.description: Role dropdown item: an ordinary column, used only as a template variable. Opens with an em dash.

wizRoleNoneHint.description: Hint under the "no role" dropdown item.

wizRoleTarget.description: Role dropdown item: the column that says where to reach the recipient. Lowercase on purpose.

wizRoleLang.description: Role dropdown item: the column that says which language the row is written in. Lowercase on purpose.

wizRoleLangHint.message: idioma da linha (um modelo por idioma)

wizRoleKey.description: Role dropdown item: the column that carries the user's own row key. Lowercase on purpose.

wizRoleKeyHint.message: a sua chave de linha no lugar da calculada

wizSampleValue.description: Tooltip of a variable chip: the first non-empty value in that column. The value is the user's data.

wizNoValues.description: Tooltip of a variable chip whose column is empty in every row.

wizEmptyPct.description: Badge on a variable chip: the share of rows where this column is blank. Keep the percent sign next to the number.

wizConflictsOne.message: $COUNT$ linha difere — decida campo a campo
wizConflictsOne.description: Heading of the conflicts block on wizard step 2.

wizConflictsFew.message: $COUNT$ linhas diferem — decida campo a campo
wizConflictsFew.description: Heading of the conflicts block on wizard step 2.

wizConflictsMany.message: $COUNT$ linhas diferem — decida campo a campo
wizConflictsMany.description: Heading of the conflicts block on wizard step 2.

wizConflictsOther.message: $COUNT$ linhas diferem — decida campo a campo
wizConflictsOther.description: Heading of the conflicts block on wizard step 2.

wizConflictTwiceInFile.description: Follows the row key of a conflict: the same key appears twice in the imported file. Lowercase — it continues the line after a middle dot.

wizConflictAlreadyInCampaign.description: Follows the row key of a conflict: the key is already stored in the campaign. Lowercase — it continues the line after a middle dot.

wizConflictColField.description: Conflict table header: which field of the row differs. Lowercase on purpose.

wizConflictColCampaign.description: Conflict table header: the value stored in the campaign. Lowercase on purpose.

wizConflictColFile.description: Conflict table header: the value the imported file carries. Lowercase on purpose.

wizConflictColAction.description: Conflict table header: what to do with this field. Lowercase on purpose.

wizChoiceFillEmpty.description: Conflict choice: write the incoming value only where the stored one is blank. Lowercase on purpose.

wizChoiceKeep.description: Conflict choice: keep the value already stored in the campaign. Lowercase on purpose.

wizChoiceTake.description: Conflict choice: overwrite with the value from the imported file. Lowercase on purpose.

wizWhoWrites.description: Heading of the sender profile card on wizard step 3.

wizNoProfile.message: Ainda não há perfil de remetente — os campos nome / e-mail / site e %my_*% ficam vazios.
wizNoProfile.description: The campaign has no sender profile. %my_*% is spintax syntax for the profile variables — keep it as it is.

wizAddProfile.description: Button that opens the sender profile drawer when there is no profile yet.

wizAddAnotherProfile.description: Button that opens the sender profile drawer when the campaign already has one.

wizManageProfiles.description: Link from wizard step 3 to the profiles screen.

wizContinueProblems.description: Primary button of wizard step 3 when the template is already saved.

wizEditFullEditor.description: Link from wizard step 3 to the template screen.

wizTemplatePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the small template editor on wizard step 3. The braces are spintax alternatives and the percent signs mark variables — keep both; translate the words inside the braces and the sentence in the parentheses. VAR1 and VAR2 are the campaign's own column variables.

wizSaveTemplate.description: Primary button that stores the step 1 message written on wizard step 3.

wizErrorsOne.description: Status line under the small template editor: how many errors the engine found, then the first ones.

wizErrorsFew.description: Status line under the small template editor: how many errors the engine found, then the first ones.

wizErrorsMany.description: Status line under the small template editor: how many errors the engine found, then the first ones.

wizErrorsOther.description: Status line under the small template editor: how many errors the engine found, then the first ones.

wizUnknownVars.description: The template uses variables the campaign does not have. VARS is a list of %name% tokens — spintax syntax, left as it is.

wizTemplateValid.description: The template parses. VARS is a list of %name% tokens — spintax syntax, left as it is.

wizVarsNone.description: Stands in for the variable list when the template uses no variables at all. Lowercase — it sits inside the sentence above.

wizSpintaxVars.message: Spintax com as suas variáveis: $VARS$. Includes, prompt de IA e prévia por linha ficam no editor completo.
wizSpintaxVars.description: Hint above the small template editor. VARS is a list of %name% tokens — spintax syntax, left as it is.

wizFullEditorLink.message: Editor completo (prompt de IA, includes, prévia)
wizFullEditorLink.description: Link from the small template editor to the template screen.

wizWhatIsWritten.message: O que é escrito — mensagem da etapa 1
wizWhatIsWritten.description: Heading of the template card on wizard step 3. "Step 1" here is the first message of the sequence, not a wizard step.

wizChipBlocking.description: Chip on wizard step 4: rows that cannot be sent as they are.

wizChipWarnings.description: Chip on wizard step 4: rows that render but look suspicious.

wizChipClean.description: Chip on wizard step 4: rows with nothing to fix.

wizChipUnchecked.message: $COUNT$ não conferidas aqui — a Revisão vê todas
wizChipUnchecked.description: Chip on wizard step 4: the screen checks the first few thousand rows only. "Review" is the name of another screen — keep it the same as the navigation item.

wizNoTemplate.message: Ainda não há modelo — volte à etapa 3.
wizNoTemplate.description: Wizard step 4 has nothing to check because the campaign has no message yet.

wizBlockingExplain.message: Bloqueio: variável obrigatória vazia, sintaxe que vazou, limite de campo estourado. Conserte o modelo ou a linha na Revisão; lá as linhas limpas são aprovadas em um clique.
wizBlockingExplain.description: Explains what counts as blocking on wizard step 4. "Review" is the name of another screen — keep it the same as the navigation item.

wizReviewCountOne.description: Link from wizard step 4 to the Review screen, with the number of rows that need attention.

wizReviewCountFew.description: Link from wizard step 4 to the Review screen, with the number of rows that need attention.

wizReviewCountMany.description: Link from wizard step 4 to the Review screen, with the number of rows that need attention.

wizReviewCountOther.description: Link from wizard step 4 to the Review screen, with the number of rows that need attention.

wizReviewAll.description: Link from wizard step 4 to the Review screen when nothing needs attention.

wizContinueQueue.description: Button of wizard step 4 that moves on to the last step.

wizHowto1.message: Abra o painel lateral (botão da barra ou o botão abaixo) — ele mostra a linha atual e a mensagem dela.
wizHowto1.description: First line of the how-to list on wizard step 5.

wizHowtoOpenTarget.description: Quotes the side panel's "Open target" button inside the how-to list — must read exactly like that button.

wizHowtoOpens.description: Follows the quoted "Open target" button in the how-to list. Keep the arrow at the front.

wizHowtoFillOnSite.description: Quotes the side panel's "Fill on <host>" button inside the how-to list; site.com is a stand-in host name — must read exactly like that button.

wizHowtoFilled.message: → os campos são preenchidos, você confere e clica em Enviar na página.
wizHowtoFilled.description: Follows the quoted "Fill on site.com" button in the how-to list. Keep the arrow at the front; "Send" is the contact form's own button on the target site.

wizHowtoSentNext.description: Quotes the side panel's "Sent — next" button inside the how-to list — must read exactly like that button.

wizHowtoRecords.message: (ou S) registra o resultado e segue; os outros resultados ficam em "Não enviado…" e "Mais…".
wizHowtoRecords.description: Follows the quoted "Sent — next" button in the how-to list. S is the keyboard shortcut — keep the letter; the two quoted names are side panel buttons.

wizHowtoShortcuts.message: Se quiser, defina os seus próprios atalhos na página de atalhos de extensões do navegador.

wizSeeList.description: Link from wizard step 5 to the List screen.
